mapper.sql: FROM oms_order_detail od INNER JOIN s_order o ON o.id = od.order_id INNER JOIN c_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN s_project p ON p.id = od.project_id

o.state IN (1, 2) AND o.appointment_state IN (1, 2) AND o.type = 0 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND od.state = 2 AND od.massagist_id IS NOT NULL AND c.phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.phone) <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM s_stat_internal_account ia WHERE ia.enabled = 1 AND ia.phone = TRIM(c.phone) )
